description:
Welcome to the RCR-F Pro, the most aerodynamic bike in the pack.
Aerodynamics, stiffness and performance are its key ingredients.

components.description: Hydraulic disc brakes:; Shimano R8170 disc brake callipers; Shimano R8170 160 mm disc front disc; Shimano R8170 140 mm rear disc
Crank length depending on frame size:R8100 cranks + INPEAK-E rechargeable power sensor (left crank); XXS and XS 165mm; S 170mm; M 172.5mm; L and XL 175mm
Ergo drops inserts to improve grip on the handlebar drops.; GPS cyclometer holder included — Garmin, Wahoo and Bryton compatible.; Option to install VR x Deda triathlon extenders.

DEDA x VR RCR-F combo to optimise aerodynamics, stiffness and ergonomics.; Handlebar widths and stem lengths depending on the frame size:; XXS 70-400; XS 80-400; S 90-420; M 100-420; L 110-440; XL 120-440; Note that the width measurements are taken at the ends of the handlebars.
Crank length depending on frame size:R8100 cranks + INPEAK-E rechargeable power sensor (left crank); XXS and XS 165mm; S 170mm; M 172.5mm; L and XL 175mm

With the rims identical to the Ultimate Series and more economical DT Swiss hubs and spokes, HADRON² Classics offer high-performance aero wheels.; Hook construction designed for optimal balance between rolling resistance and aerodynamic performance.; With a 62 mm rim height, these wheels are ideal for rolling terrain.
SRCR-F carbon offset seat post -15; Length depending on frame sizes:; XXS 268mm; XS 314mm; S 330mm; M 352mm; L 400mm; XL 410mm
GP 5000S TR 28 section tyre at the rear.
Continental Aero 111 TLR 26 section tyre at the front.

Recommendation: switch your tyres to tubeless with the tubeless valve and preventive fluid that come with this bike:; Tubeless is more comfortable with better performance, and the tyres can self-repair when you get small pinches.; Of course, you should always carry an inner tube in your repair kit, just in case your tyre gets a bigger puncture.
